evidence.quote: The biggest worry is that basically it makes all participating SCs freezable without even advertising this as a feature. Why? The builders could collude to just stop attesting, then all the protected functions would just always revert until they decide to start attesting again. It's only the protected functions but how many SCs/ apps function with only some
BUT, there is a reasonable way to implement this which they offer--a fail-open condition that means if attestation stops for too long, the gated functions can succeed again.

We've seen in the past how it is too hard to monitor individual users' configurations of systems (see LayerZero KelpDAO issue blamed essentially on user config error) . IMO what should be done as a mitigation for the benefit of Ethereum ecosystem is to make the fail-open MANDATORY and make the guard-upgrades mandatorily have timelocked upgrade (at minimum)

The appropriate 'pressure' imo is not to just condemn this widely but rather to suggest to @phylaxsystems that fail-open & slow guard upgrade be mandatory rather than a user config parameter, for the integrity of Ethereum.

evidence.quote: Since then we've had a market crash and a few sector recoveries, and Manatee keep chugging along. It's up 2.15% net with a 98% win rate, 49 of 50 closed trades.

How it works: once a day, at the daily close, it looks at the most liquid names on Hyperliquid across crypto, stocks and commodities. Anything that closes 5% or more below its 7 day average gets bought, anything 5% above gets shorted, at 2x leverage and small size. Then a stop ladder checks every 30 seconds and banks the gain when the price snaps back.

The most useful thing the AI learned came from backtesting. Stocks and commodities made about 1% per trade after fees, while crypto made close to nothing, and a crypto-only Manatee would have lost money. The timing mattered just as much: the same rule checked every 4 hours instead of once a day also lost money after fees.

Then the market tested it. From 1 to 4 November the open positions were down as much as 18% of the account. Manatee held them and added to the most stretched names, and over the past week it has been harvesting them one by one as they reverted. Today was its best day yet.

items.summary: qinbafrank解读OKXICE为何选赋予发行公司反对权的SEC创新豁免路径：Robinhood、Coinbase股票代币均不对美国人士开放，OKXICE则要直接服务美国客户；作者视上市公司反对为阶段性阻力。
items.author: qinbafrank
items.new_information: 解释OKXICE以美国客户为目标，因此须承担发行公司反对权这一制度成本

evidence.quote: OKXICE选择的SEC美国交易场所豁免路径，这种机制明确赋予发行公司反对权。它如果要采用这套方案，那么收到一些美股公司的反对也不奇怪。其实很多反对的美股上市公司并不是完全反对代币化进程，只是有一些他们不能理解的分歧在里面。
如果主要目标只是做境外股票挂钩产品，确实可以考虑其他法律结构。例如coinbase和robinhood现在的模式、完全不需要股票发行公司是否同意、直接就推出了把股票代币化、但是他们两家的代币化只能面向非美用户推出。
看到了么？robinhood和coinbase现在的代币化产品都不向美国用户开放。而OKXICE想要的恰恰是直接切入美国本土，向美国境内的零售与机构客户提供代币化产品，而这是另一个需要独立解决的市场。
站在SEC的角度，之前其主席Atkins也明确表态这项临时豁免的定位是为通向后续长期规则的过渡安排，那意味着现在采用这种机制虽然当下会面临一些阻力、但是一旦SEC推出了长期规则那么就会自动获得在未来长期规则下的优先权。所以如果终点是美国境内的链上股票市场，那么通知发行公司是OKXICE选择这条路径必须支付的制度成本。
从产业发展看，这轮反对对美国股票AMM路线构成了实际阻力，但都是产业趋势发展过程中的阶段性阻力，并不会让RWA代币化趋势。
